description: Regression fixture for the mechanism-entanglement lesson (the core motivation for the ordered-test-list work). The test is NAMED for a filtering behaviour ('returns only active users') but its seed is shaped to span the fetch BATCH_SIZE (150 rows across two batches), entangling the batching mechanism with the active-filter behaviour. The minimal seed for the named rule is ~2 active + 1 inactive; batching, if it matters, deserves its own explicit test with the knob made visible. The test-reviewer must flag the over-seeding / mechanism entanglement (minimal fixture data). We assert FAIL coarsely.
